mapper.sql: fsr.id, fsr.submitted_by_user_id, u.nickname AS submitter_nickname, u.email AS submitter_email, fsr.status, fsr.name, fsr.brand, fsr.serving_description, fsr.serving_size, fsr.serving_unit, fsr.calories, fsr.carbohydrate, fsr.protein, fsr.fat, fsr.admin_note, fsr.rejection_reason, fsr.approved_food_id, fsr.reviewed_by_admin_id, fsr.submitted_at, fsr.reviewed_at, fsr.created_at, fsr.updated_at
mapper.select: INSERT INTO food_submission_requests ( submitted_by_user_id, name, brand, serving_description, serving_size, serving_unit, calories, carbohydrate, protein, fat ) VALUES ( #{request.submittedByUserId}, #{request.name}, #{request.brand}, #{request.servingDescription}, #{request.servingSize}, #{request.servingUnit}, #{request.calories}, #{request.carbohydrate}, #{request.protein}, #{request.fat} ) RETURNING id

SELECT
FROM food_submission_requests fsr JOIN users u ON u.id = fsr.submitted_by_user_id WHERE fsr.id = #{requestId}

SELECT
FROM food_submission_requests fsr JOIN users u ON u.id = fsr.submitted_by_user_id WHERE fsr.id = #{requestId} FOR UPDATE OF fsr
SELECT id FROM foods WHERE source_key = #{sourceKey} AND serving_key = COALESCE(#{servingDescription}, '') LIMIT 1

INSERT INTO foods ( source_key, source_url, name, brand, serving_description, serving_size, serving_unit, calories, carbohydrate, protein, fat, content_hash ) VALUES ( #{sourceKey}, #{sourceUrl}, #{name}, #{brand}, #{servingDescription}, #{servingSize}, #{servingUnit}, #{calories}, #{carbohydrate}, #{protein}, #{fat}, #{contentHash} ) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE food_submission_requests SET status = 'APPROVED', name = #{name}, brand = #{brand}, serving_description = #{servingDescription}, serving_size = #{servingSize}, serving_unit = #{servingUnit}, calories = #{calories}, carbohydrate = #{carbohydrate}, protein = #{protein}, fat = #{fat}, admin_note = #{adminNote}, rejection_reason = NULL, approved_food_id = #{foodId}, reviewed_by_admin_id = #{adminId}, reviewed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{requestId} AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE food_submission_requests SET status = 'REJECTED', rejection_reason = #{rejectionReason}, reviewed_by_admin_id = #{adminId}, reviewed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{requestId} AND status = 'PENDING'
